lessons.title: Build the Task Module
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: This lesson is about Build the Task Module. Keep the idea practical: in the NestJS/Fastify TaskFlow API, the worked example should show that the feature has explicit HTTP, application, validation, and test boundaries rather than putting all behavior in one controller file. Once you can explain why that happens, the name is much easier to remember. We connect it to the course project so you can see the idea working instead of memorizing a definition.
